original.statement: cert-manager 1.17.0 adds a new Helm value `webhook.extraEnv` that allows setting custom environment variables in the webhook Pod (the same release note / PR #7317 also adds the analogous values `cainjector.extraEnv` and `startupapicheck.extraEnv`, which are separate subjects of the same addition).

decision.reason: [ev-fe0fca386a7a] describes `webhook.extraEnv` as a new, optional Helm value that adds custom environment variables to the webhook Pod. The only environments where anything differs are those that set the key, so values-key{webhook.extraEnv, set} is the right scope. P3's condition is wrong: it flags environments that leave the keys unset, and it bundles in the cainjector and startupapicheck keys. The validator finding that the key already appears in the v1.16.0 values file [ev-fdc96eee87bf] casts doubt on the 'added' change type but does not change who is exposed, so confidence is low.
